about: Curated roadmap. Each item has one state: planned, implemented, tested, accepted or released. 'implemented' means the code exists; 'tested' means our own automated or measured checks passed; 'accepted' means the owner or a real player run confirmed it; 'released' means a supported download exists. A merged pull request is not a state. Evidence dates say when the state was last confirmed. Keep this file public-safe: no addresses, names or keys.
